summary: Analyzes security threats against the Access Node Control Protocol (ANCP), which carries QoS and subscriber configuration between a network access server and an access node such as a DSLAM. It then lists the security requirements the protocol should meet. It is informational.

eli5.summary: ANCP lets the main office tell a local broadband box how to treat each customer. This document asks what bad things an attacker could do to those messages and what protections are needed.

questions: what are the security threats to ancp
what is the access node control protocol
